verdict.rationale: Floot's core product is an AI chat assistant that builds, debugs, and manages full-stack apps via natural-language delegation — including running SQL, fetching logs, creating checkpoints, generating images, and scaffolding integrations — all driven from AI chat (floot-docs-1, floot-docs-3, floot-docs-4, floot-docs-5, floot-docs-7, floot-docs-26). This is a first-party, built-in assistant, not a bolt-on. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the assistant's task delegation in practice, and more detail on the assistant's autonomy limits.
